name: potatofarm-mobile
//: Every dependency here is derived from what the source actually
imports, not from memory. There was no manifest at all until now —
the app has never been installable, which is worth knowing before
anyone plans a pilot around it.
Versions are pinned rather than caret-ranged. These are native
modules: a minor bump means a rebuild and a resubmission, not an
npm install, and a range turns that into a surprise.
